meta.title: Fully Collapsible Left Sidebar
meta.description: The left sidebar collapses to nothing — no leftover icon rail, no reserved space — and glides in and out just like the right sidebar. The brand icon and wordmark are gone, and the toggle lives in one place only: at the top of the sidebar while it is open, at the top of the conversation once it is hidden. On phones it slides over the conversation as a full-screen panel and closes itself after you pick or start a session; on desktop nothing changes — same width, and the conversation makes room as before.
